name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All nine trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and training success was also 0 in every run. This held across three architecture families (the start net, the layer-conditioned head and the layer-sliced net) and across recipes (more updates, 1 or 2 epochs, 3x the samples, small output initialisation). Seed noise alone cannot explain this. A dense shaped reward with roughly 400k samples should give at least occasional exact builds, so something basic is probably broken. The task warns that the world may not match its description. One likely mismatch is that the action indexing is not aligned with the observation grid (transposed, flipped, or a different anchor). If so, every convolutional footprint head we tried puts each action's logit at the wrong cells, and a local convolution cannot learn that non-local shift. This last round tests that idea with heads that can learn any mapping from cells to actions.
